# Test fixture: every RIP government reform, one option each, with the conditions it asks for.
# Generated by tests/dev_tools/make_government_reform_test.py; do not edit by hand.
# Not loaded by the game: it lives in tests/dev_tools/, not events/.
#
# To run: python tests/dev_tools/make_government_reform_test.py --install, start a disposable
# non-Ironman game, enter `event rip_gov_test.1` in the console, and pick a polity and a reform.
# Afterwards run --remove. The fixture annexes countries and changes tag, religion and culture.
#
# Each option fires, in order, a hidden apply event (rip_gov_test.1000 + n) and a result window
# (rip_gov_test.2000 + n). The apply event resets the government by switching to another type and
# back, grants the conditions, evaluates the reform's own potential and trigger before adding the
# reform and writes RIP_GOV_TEST markers to game.log:
#   BEGIN / GRANT_FAIL (a planned item is missing; last word says which) / POT_OK|POT_FAIL|POT_NONE /
#   TRG_OK|TRG_FAIL|TRG_NONE / HELD_OK|HELD_FAIL, each followed by <reform> <type>
# `*` in a button marks a reform with a condition script cannot give (the date, an institution
# that is not enabled yet, an age); its POT_FAIL or TRG_FAIL is expected.
# The battery option applies all variants in one go; --report reads the markers.

namespace = rip_gov_test

country_event = {
	id = rip_gov_test.1001
	title = rip_gov_test.t
	desc = rip_gov_test.d
	picture = ADMINISTRATIVE_REFORM_eventPicture
	hidden = yes
	is_triggered_only = yes
	option = { name = rip_gov_test.a }
	immediate = {
		# chr_dzhura_corps_reform | monarchy | feudalism_vs_autocracy
		log = "RIP_GOV_TEST BEGIN chr_dzhura_corps_reform monarchy"
		country_event = { id = rip_gov_test.90 }
		# a switch to another type drops every reform; the switch back leaves the basic one
		change_government = republic
		change_government = monarchy
		set_country_flag = chr_stage_dzhura_open
		if = { limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = chr_stage_dzhura_open } } set_country_flag = rip_gov_test_fail log = "RIP_GOV_TEST GRANT_FAIL chr_dzhura_corps_reform monarchy flag:chr_stage_dzhura_open" }
		set_country_flag = rip_gov_test_chk_pot
		if = {
			limit = {
				chr_dzhura_corps_visible = yes
			}
			clr_country_flag = rip_gov_test_chk_pot
			log = "RIP_GOV_TEST POT_OK chr_dzhura_corps_reform monarchy"
		}
		if = { limit = { has_country_flag = rip_gov_test_chk_pot } clr_country_flag = rip_gov_test_chk_pot set_country_flag = rip_gov_test_fail log = "RIP_GOV_TEST POT_FAIL chr_dzhura_corps_reform monarchy" }
		set_country_flag = rip_gov_test_chk_trg
		if = {
			limit = {
				chr_dzhura_corps_visible = yes
			}
			clr_country_flag = rip_gov_test_chk_trg
			log = "RIP_GOV_TEST TRG_OK chr_dzhura_corps_reform monarchy"
		}
		if = { limit = { has_country_flag = rip_gov_test_chk_trg } clr_country_flag = rip_gov_test_chk_trg set_country_flag = rip_gov_test_fail log = "RIP_GOV_TEST TRG_FAIL chr_dzhura_corps_reform monarchy" }
		add_government_reform = chr_dzhura_corps_reform
		if = { limit = { has_reform = chr_dzhura_corps_reform } log = "RIP_GOV_TEST HELD_OK chr_dzhura_corps_reform monarchy" }
		if = { limit = { NOT = { has_reform = chr_dzhura_corps_reform } } set_country_flag = rip_gov_test_fail log = "RIP_GOV_TEST HELD_FAIL chr_dzhura_corps_reform monarchy" }
	}
}

country_event = {
	id = rip_gov_test.1005
	title = rip_gov_test.t
	desc = rip_gov_test.d
	picture = ADMINISTRATIVE_REFORM_eventPicture
	hidden = yes
	is_triggered_only = yes
	option = { name = rip_gov_test.a }
	immediate = {
		# chr_vetka_asylum_reform | monarchy | state_and_religion
		log = "RIP_GOV_TEST BEGIN chr_vetka_asylum_reform monarchy"
		country_event = { id = rip_gov_test.90 }
		# a switch to another type drops every reform; the switch back leaves the basic one
		change_government = republic
		change_government = monarchy
		if = { limit = { NOT = { tag = CHR } }
			if = { limit = { exists = CHR } inherit = CHR }
			change_tag = CHR
			on_change_tag_effect = yes
		}
		if = { limit = { NOT = { religion = orthodox } } change_religion = orthodox }
		if = { limit = { NOT = { tag = CHR } } set_country_flag = rip_gov_test_fail log = "RIP_GOV_TEST GRANT_FAIL chr_vetka_asylum_reform monarchy tag:CHR" }
		if = { limit = { NOT = { religion = orthodox } } set_country_flag = rip_gov_test_fail log = "RIP_GOV_TEST GRANT_FAIL chr_vetka_asylum_reform monarchy religion:orthodox" }
		set_country_flag = rip_gov_test_chk_pot
		if = {
			limit = {
				chr_vetka_visible = yes
			}
			clr_country_flag = rip_gov_test_chk_pot

country_event = {
	id = rip_gov_test.1006
	title = rip_gov_test.t
	desc = rip_gov_test.d
	picture = ADMINISTRATIVE_REFORM_eventPicture
	hidden = yes
	is_triggered_only = yes
	option = { name = rip_gov_test.a }
	immediate = {
		# chr_grain_directorate_reform | monarchy | economical_matters
		log = "RIP_GOV_TEST BEGIN chr_grain_directorate_reform monarchy"
		country_event = { id = rip_gov_test.90 }
		# a switch to another type drops every reform; the switch back leaves the basic one
		change_government = republic
		change_government = monarchy
		if = { limit = { NOT = { tag = CHR } }
			if = { limit = { exists = CHR } inherit = CHR }
			change_tag = CHR
			on_change_tag_effect = yes
		}
		set_country_flag = chr_agro_hypercorp_complete
		if = { limit = { NOT = { tag = CHR } } set_country_flag = rip_gov_test_fail log = "RIP_GOV_TEST GRANT_FAIL chr_grain_directorate_reform monarchy tag:CHR" }
		if = { limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = chr_agro_hypercorp_complete } } set_country_flag = rip_gov_test_fail log = "RIP_GOV_TEST GRANT_FAIL chr_grain_directorate_reform monarchy flag:chr_agro_hypercorp_complete" }
		set_country_flag = rip_gov_test_chk_pot
		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					tag = CHR
					has_reform = chr_grain_directorate_reform
				}
			}
			clr_country_flag = rip_gov_test_chk_pot
			log = "RIP_GOV_TEST POT_OK chr_grain_directorate_reform monarchy"
		}
		if = { limit = { has_country_flag = rip_gov_test_chk_pot } clr_country_flag = rip_gov_test_chk_pot set_country_flag = rip_gov_test_fail log = "RIP_GOV_TEST POT_FAIL chr_grain_directorate_reform monarchy" }
		set_country_flag = rip_gov_test_chk_trg
		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					has_reform = chr_grain_directorate_reform
					AND = {
						tag = CHR
						custom_trigger_tooltip = {
							tooltip = chr_agro_hypercorp_complete_req_tt
							chr_agro_hypercorp_completed = yes
						}
					}
				}
			}
			clr_country_flag = rip_gov_test_chk_trg
			log = "RIP_GOV_TEST TRG_OK chr_grain_directorate_reform monarchy"
		}
		if = { limit = { has_country_flag = rip_gov_test_chk_trg } clr_country_flag = rip_gov_test_chk_trg set_country_flag = rip_gov_test_fail log = "RIP_GOV_TEST TRG_FAIL chr_grain_directorate_reform monarchy" }
		add_government_reform = chr_grain_directorate_reform
		if = { limit = { has_reform = chr_grain_directorate_reform } log = "RIP_GOV_TEST HELD_OK chr_grain_directorate_reform monarchy" }
		if = { limit = { NOT = { has_reform = chr_grain_directorate_reform } } set_country_flag = rip_gov_test_fail log = "RIP_GOV_TEST HELD_FAIL chr_grain_directorate_reform monarchy" }
	}
}

	immediate = {

		log = "RIP_GOV_TEST BEGIN chr_grain_directorate_reform republic"

			on_change_tag_effect = yes

		set_country_flag = chr_agro_hypercorp_complete
		if = { limit = { NOT = { tag = CHR } } set_country_flag = rip_gov_test_fail log = "RIP_GOV_TEST GRANT_FAIL chr_grain_directorate_reform republic tag:CHR" }

					tag = CHR
					has_reform = chr_grain_directorate_reform
				}
			}
			clr_country_flag = rip_gov_test_chk_pot
			log = "RIP_GOV_TEST POT_OK chr_grain_directorate_reform republic"
		}
		if = { limit = { has_country_flag = rip_gov_test_chk_pot } clr_country_flag = rip_gov_test_chk_pot set_country_flag = rip_gov_test_fail log = "RIP_GOV_TEST POT_FAIL chr_grain_directorate_reform republic" }

					has_reform = chr_grain_directorate_reform

							tooltip = chr_agro_hypercorp_complete_req_tt

				}
			}
			clr_country_flag = rip_gov_test_chk_trg
			log = "RIP_GOV_TEST TRG_OK chr_grain_directorate_reform republic"
		}
		if = { limit = { has_country_flag = rip_gov_test_chk_trg } clr_country_flag = rip_gov_test_chk_trg set_country_flag = rip_gov_test_fail log = "RIP_GOV_TEST TRG_FAIL chr_grain_directorate_reform republic" }

									has_institution = global_trade
									current_age = age_of_absolutism
								}
								liberty_desire = 65
								army_size_percentage = 0.8
								manpower_percentage = 0.75
							}
						}
					}
				}
			}
			clr_country_flag = rip_gov_test_chk_trg
			log = "RIP_GOV_TEST TRG_OK zaz_last_sich_reform republic"
		}
		if = { limit = { has_country_flag = rip_gov_test_chk_trg } clr_country_flag = rip_gov_test_chk_trg set_country_flag = rip_gov_test_fail log = "RIP_GOV_TEST TRG_FAIL zaz_last_sich_reform republic" }
		add_government_reform = zaz_last_sich_reform
		if = { limit = { has_reform = zaz_last_sich_reform } log = "RIP_GOV_TEST HELD_OK zaz_last_sich_reform republic" }
		if = { limit = { NOT = { has_reform = zaz_last_sich_reform } } set_country_flag = rip_gov_test_fail log = "RIP_GOV_TEST HELD_FAIL zaz_last_sich_reform republic" }
	}
}

					has_reform = kyivan_church_synod_reform
					AND = {
						OR = {
							tag = KIE
							tag = KRU
						}
						has_country_flag = kyiv_church_synod_established
					}
				}
			}
			clr_country_flag = rip_gov_test_chk_trg
			log = "RIP_GOV_TEST TRG_OK kyivan_church_synod_reform theocracy"
		}
		if = { limit = { has_country_flag = rip_gov_test_chk_trg } clr_country_flag = rip_gov_test_chk_trg set_country_flag = rip_gov_test_fail log = "RIP_GOV_TEST TRG_FAIL kyivan_church_synod_reform theocracy" }
		add_government_reform = kyivan_church_synod_reform
		if = { limit = { has_reform = kyivan_church_synod_reform } log = "RIP_GOV_TEST HELD_OK kyivan_church_synod_reform theocracy" }
		if = { limit = { NOT = { has_reform = kyivan_church_synod_reform } } set_country_flag = rip_gov_test_fail log = "RIP_GOV_TEST HELD_FAIL kyivan_church_synod_reform theocracy" }
	}
}

			on_change_tag_effect = yes

		if = { limit = { has_reform = hlc_boyar_republic_reform } log = "RIP_GOV_TEST HELD_OK hlc_boyar_republic_reform republic" }
		if = { limit = { NOT = { has_reform = hlc_boyar_republic_reform } } set_country_flag = rip_gov_test_fail log = "RIP_GOV_TEST HELD_FAIL hlc_boyar_republic_reform republic" }
	}

country_event = {
	id = rip_gov_test.1052
	title = rip_gov_test.t
	desc = rip_gov_test.d
	picture = ADMINISTRATIVE_REFORM_eventPicture
	hidden = yes
	is_triggered_only = yes
	option = { name = rip_gov_test.a }
	immediate = {
		# hlc_boyar_oligarchy_reform | republic | republican_virtues
		log = "RIP_GOV_TEST BEGIN hlc_boyar_oligarchy_reform republic"
		country_event = { id = rip_gov_test.90 }
		# a switch to another type drops every reform; the switch back leaves the basic one
		change_government = monarchy
		change_government = republic
		if = { limit = { NOT = { tag = HLC } }
			if = { limit = { exists = HLC } inherit = HLC }
			change_tag = HLC
			on_change_tag_effect = yes
		}
		set_country_flag = rip_galicia_path_boyar
		add_government_reform = hlc_boyar_republic_reform
		if = { limit = { NOT = { tag = HLC } } set_country_flag = rip_gov_test_fail log = "RIP_GOV_TEST GRANT_FAIL hlc_boyar_oligarchy_reform republic tag:HLC" }
		if = { limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = rip_galicia_path_boyar } } set_country_flag = rip_gov_test_fail log = "RIP_GOV_TEST GRANT_FAIL hlc_boyar_oligarchy_reform republic flag:rip_galicia_path_boyar" }
		if = { limit = { NOT = { has_reform = hlc_boyar_republic_reform } } set_country_flag = rip_gov_test_fail log = "RIP_GOV_TEST GRANT_FAIL hlc_boyar_oligarchy_reform republic reform:hlc_boyar_republic_reform" }
		set_country_flag = rip_gov_test_chk_pot
		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					has_reform = hlc_boyar_oligarchy_reform
					has_reform = hlc_boyar_republic_reform
				}
			}
			clr_country_flag = rip_gov_test_chk_pot
			log = "RIP_GOV_TEST POT_OK hlc_boyar_oligarchy_reform republic"
		}
		if = { limit = { has_country_flag = rip_gov_test_chk_pot } clr_country_flag = rip_gov_test_chk_pot set_country_flag = rip_gov_test_fail log = "RIP_GOV_TEST POT_FAIL hlc_boyar_oligarchy_reform republic" }
		set_country_flag = rip_gov_test_chk_trg
		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					has_reform = hlc_boyar_oligarchy_reform
					has_reform = hlc_boyar_republic_reform
				}
			}
			clr_country_flag = rip_gov_test_chk_trg
			log = "RIP_GOV_TEST TRG_OK hlc_boyar_oligarchy_reform republic"
		}
		if = { limit = { has_country_flag = rip_gov_test_chk_trg } clr_country_flag = rip_gov_test_chk_trg set_country_flag = rip_gov_test_fail log = "RIP_GOV_TEST TRG_FAIL hlc_boyar_oligarchy_reform republic" }
		add_government_reform = hlc_boyar_oligarchy_reform
		if = { limit = { has_reform = hlc_boyar_oligarchy_reform } log = "RIP_GOV_TEST HELD_OK hlc_boyar_oligarchy_reform republic" }
		if = { limit = { NOT = { has_reform = hlc_boyar_oligarchy_reform } } set_country_flag = rip_gov_test_fail log = "RIP_GOV_TEST HELD_FAIL hlc_boyar_oligarchy_reform republic" }
	}
}

country_event = {
	id = rip_gov_test.1054
	title = rip_gov_test.t
	desc = rip_gov_test.d
	picture = ADMINISTRATIVE_REFORM_eventPicture
	hidden = yes
	is_triggered_only = yes
	option = { name = rip_gov_test.a }
	immediate = {
		# hlc_halych_metropolitanate_reform | theocracy | theocratic_leadership
		log = "RIP_GOV_TEST BEGIN hlc_halych_metropolitanate_reform theocracy"
		country_event = { id = rip_gov_test.90 }
		# a switch to another type drops every reform; the switch back leaves the basic one
		change_government = monarchy
		change_government = theocracy
		if = { limit = { NOT = { tag = HLC } }
			if = { limit = { exists = HLC } inherit = HLC }
			change_tag = HLC
			on_change_tag_effect = yes
		}
		if = { limit = { NOT = { religion = orthodox } } change_religion = orthodox }
		set_country_flag = rip_galicia_path_metropolitanate
		if = { limit = { NOT = { tag = HLC } } set_country_flag = rip_gov_test_fail log = "RIP_GOV_TEST GRANT_FAIL hlc_halych_metropolitanate_reform theocracy tag:HLC" }
		if = { limit = { NOT = { religion = orthodox } } set_country_flag = rip_gov_test_fail log = "RIP_GOV_TEST GRANT_FAIL hlc_halych_metropolitanate_reform theocracy religion:orthodox" }
		if = { limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = rip_galicia_path_metropolitanate } } set_country_flag = rip_gov_test_fail log = "RIP_GOV_TEST GRANT_FAIL hlc_halych_metropolitanate_reform theocracy flag:rip_galicia_path_metropolitanate" }
		set_country_flag = rip_gov_test_chk_pot
		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					has_reform = hlc_halych_metropolitanate_reform
					AND = {
						west_ukraine_hlc_origin_country = yes
						OR = {
							religion = orthodox
							religion = greek_catholic
						}
					}
				}
			}
			clr_country_flag = rip_gov_test_chk_pot
			log = "RIP_GOV_TEST POT_OK hlc_halych_metropolitanate_reform theocracy"
		}
		if = { limit = { has_country_flag = rip_gov_test_chk_pot } clr_country_flag = rip_gov_test_chk_pot set_country_flag = rip_gov_test_fail log = "RIP_GOV_TEST POT_FAIL hlc_halych_metropolitanate_reform theocracy" }
		set_country_flag = rip_gov_test_chk_trg
		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					has_reform = hlc_halych_metropolitanate_reform
					AND = {
						west_ukraine_hlc_origin_country = yes
						OR = {
							religion = orthodox
							religion = greek_catholic
						}
						custom_trigger_tooltip = {
							tooltip = hlc_path_metropolitanate_req_tt
							hlc_has_metropolitanate_path = yes
						}
					}
				}
			}
			clr_country_flag = rip_gov_test_chk_trg
			log = "RIP_GOV_TEST TRG_OK hlc_halych_metropolitanate_reform theocracy"
		}
		if = { limit = { has_country_flag = rip_gov_test_chk_trg } clr_country_flag = rip_gov_test_chk_trg set_country_flag = rip_gov_test_fail log = "RIP_GOV_TEST TRG_FAIL hlc_halych_metropolitanate_reform theocracy" }
		add_government_reform = hlc_halych_metropolitanate_reform
		if = { limit = { has_reform = hlc_halych_metropolitanate_reform } log = "RIP_GOV_TEST HELD_OK hlc_halych_metropolitanate_reform theocracy" }
		if = { limit = { NOT = { has_reform = hlc_halych_metropolitanate_reform } } set_country_flag = rip_gov_test_fail log = "RIP_GOV_TEST HELD_FAIL hlc_halych_metropolitanate_reform theocracy" }
	}
}

country_event = {
	id = rip_gov_test.1061
	title = rip_gov_test.t
	desc = rip_gov_test.d
	picture = ADMINISTRATIVE_REFORM_eventPicture
	hidden = yes
	is_triggered_only = yes
	option = { name = rip_gov_test.a }
	immediate = {
		# vln_black_voivode_legion | monarchy | military_doctrines
		log = "RIP_GOV_TEST BEGIN vln_black_voivode_legion monarchy"
		country_event = { id = rip_gov_test.90 }
		# a switch to another type drops every reform; the switch back leaves the basic one
		change_government = republic
		change_government = monarchy
		if = { limit = { NOT = { tag = VLN } }
			if = { limit = { exists = VLN } inherit = VLN }
			change_tag = VLN
			on_change_tag_effect = yes
		}
		if = { limit = { NOT = { army_professionalism = 0.4 } } add_army_professionalism = 1 }
		if = { limit = { NOT = { tag = VLN } } set_country_flag = rip_gov_test_fail log = "RIP_GOV_TEST GRANT_FAIL vln_black_voivode_legion monarchy tag:VLN" }
		if = { limit = { NOT = { army_professionalism = 0.4 } } set_country_flag = rip_gov_test_fail log = "RIP_GOV_TEST GRANT_FAIL vln_black_voivode_legion monarchy stat:army_professionalism" }
		set_country_flag = rip_gov_test_chk_pot
		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					west_ukraine_vln_origin_country = yes
					has_reform = vln_black_voivode_legion
				}
			}
			clr_country_flag = rip_gov_test_chk_pot
			log = "RIP_GOV_TEST POT_OK vln_black_voivode_legion monarchy"
		}
		if = { limit = { has_country_flag = rip_gov_test_chk_pot } clr_country_flag = rip_gov_test_chk_pot set_country_flag = rip_gov_test_fail log = "RIP_GOV_TEST POT_FAIL vln_black_voivode_legion monarchy" }
		set_country_flag = rip_gov_test_chk_trg
		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					has_reform = vln_black_voivode_legion
					AND = {
						west_ukraine_vln_origin_country = yes
						if = {
							limit = {
								has_dlc = "Cradle of Civilization"
							}
							army_professionalism = 0.4
						}
						else = {
							army_tradition = 60
						}
					}
				}
			}
			clr_country_flag = rip_gov_test_chk_trg
			log = "RIP_GOV_TEST TRG_OK vln_black_voivode_legion monarchy"
		}
		if = { limit = { has_country_flag = rip_gov_test_chk_trg } clr_country_flag = rip_gov_test_chk_trg set_country_flag = rip_gov_test_fail log = "RIP_GOV_TEST TRG_FAIL vln_black_voivode_legion monarchy" }
		add_government_reform = vln_black_voivode_legion
		if = { limit = { has_reform = vln_black_voivode_legion } log = "RIP_GOV_TEST HELD_OK vln_black_voivode_legion monarchy" }
		if = { limit = { NOT = { has_reform = vln_black_voivode_legion } } set_country_flag = rip_gov_test_fail log = "RIP_GOV_TEST HELD_FAIL vln_black_voivode_legion monarchy" }
	}
}

		set_country_flag = rip_vln_path_sejmik
		add_government_reform = vln_sejmik_republic_reform
		if = { limit = { NOT = { tag = VLN } } set_country_flag = rip_gov_test_fail log = "RIP_GOV_TEST GRANT_FAIL vln_dietine_instructions_reform republic tag:VLN" }
		if = { limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = rip_vln_path_sejmik } } set_country_flag = rip_gov_test_fail log = "RIP_GOV_TEST GRANT_FAIL vln_dietine_instructions_reform republic flag:rip_vln_path_sejmik" }
		if = { limit = { NOT = { has_reform = vln_sejmik_republic_reform } } set_country_flag = rip_gov_test_fail log = "RIP_GOV_TEST GRANT_FAIL vln_dietine_instructions_reform republic reform:vln_sejmik_republic_reform" }
		set_country_flag = rip_gov_test_chk_pot
		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					has_reform = vln_dietine_instructions_reform
					has_reform = vln_sejmik_republic_reform
				}
			}
			clr_country_flag = rip_gov_test_chk_pot
			log = "RIP_GOV_TEST POT_OK vln_dietine_instructions_reform republic"
		}
		if = { limit = { has_country_flag = rip_gov_test_chk_pot } clr_country_flag = rip_gov_test_chk_pot set_country_flag = rip_gov_test_fail log = "RIP_GOV_TEST POT_FAIL vln_dietine_instructions_reform republic" }
		set_country_flag = rip_gov_test_chk_trg
		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					has_reform = vln_dietine_instructions_reform
					has_reform = vln_sejmik_republic_reform
				}
			}
			clr_country_flag = rip_gov_test_chk_trg
			log = "RIP_GOV_TEST TRG_OK vln_dietine_instructions_reform republic"
		}
		if = { limit = { has_country_flag = rip_gov_test_chk_trg } clr_country_flag = rip_gov_test_chk_trg set_country_flag = rip_gov_test_fail log = "RIP_GOV_TEST TRG_FAIL vln_dietine_instructions_reform republic" }
		add_government_reform = vln_dietine_instructions_reform
		if = { limit = { has_reform = vln_dietine_instructions_reform } log = "RIP_GOV_TEST HELD_OK vln_dietine_instructions_reform republic" }
		if = { limit = { NOT = { has_reform = vln_dietine_instructions_reform } } set_country_flag = rip_gov_test_fail log = "RIP_GOV_TEST HELD_FAIL vln_dietine_instructions_reform republic" }
	}

country_event = {
	id = rip_gov_test.1067
	title = rip_gov_test.t
	desc = rip_gov_test.d
	picture = ADMINISTRATIVE_REFORM_eventPicture
	hidden = yes
	is_triggered_only = yes
	option = { name = rip_gov_test.a }
	immediate = {
		# pdl_clan_assembly_reform | monarchy | feudalism_vs_autocracy
		log = "RIP_GOV_TEST BEGIN pdl_clan_assembly_reform monarchy"
		country_event = { id = rip_gov_test.90 }
		# a switch to another type drops every reform; the switch back leaves the basic one
		change_government = republic
		change_government = monarchy
		if = { limit = { NOT = { tag = PDL } }
			if = { limit = { exists = PDL } inherit = PDL }
			change_tag = PDL
			on_change_tag_effect = yes
		}
		set_country_flag = pdl_frontier_path
		if = { limit = { NOT = { tag = PDL } } set_country_flag = rip_gov_test_fail log = "RIP_GOV_TEST GRANT_FAIL pdl_clan_assembly_reform monarchy tag:PDL" }
		if = { limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = pdl_frontier_path } } set_country_flag = rip_gov_test_fail log = "RIP_GOV_TEST GRANT_FAIL pdl_clan_assembly_reform monarchy flag:pdl_frontier_path" }
		set_country_flag = rip_gov_test_chk_pot
		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					has_reform = pdl_clan_assembly_reform
					AND = {
						west_ukraine_pdl_origin_country = yes
						has_country_flag = pdl_frontier_path
					}
				}
			}
			clr_country_flag = rip_gov_test_chk_pot
			log = "RIP_GOV_TEST POT_OK pdl_clan_assembly_reform monarchy"
		}
		if = { limit = { has_country_flag = rip_gov_test_chk_pot } clr_country_flag = rip_gov_test_chk_pot set_country_flag = rip_gov_test_fail log = "RIP_GOV_TEST POT_FAIL pdl_clan_assembly_reform monarchy" }
		set_country_flag = rip_gov_test_chk_trg
		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					has_reform = pdl_clan_assembly_reform
					AND = {
						west_ukraine_pdl_origin_country = yes
						has_country_flag = pdl_frontier_path
					}
				}
			}
			clr_country_flag = rip_gov_test_chk_trg
			log = "RIP_GOV_TEST TRG_OK pdl_clan_assembly_reform monarchy"
		}
		if = { limit = { has_country_flag = rip_gov_test_chk_trg } clr_country_flag = rip_gov_test_chk_trg set_country_flag = rip_gov_test_fail log = "RIP_GOV_TEST TRG_FAIL pdl_clan_assembly_reform monarchy" }
		add_government_reform = pdl_clan_assembly_reform
		if = { limit = { has_reform = pdl_clan_assembly_reform } log = "RIP_GOV_TEST HELD_OK pdl_clan_assembly_reform monarchy" }
		if = { limit = { NOT = { has_reform = pdl_clan_assembly_reform } } set_country_flag = rip_gov_test_fail log = "RIP_GOV_TEST HELD_FAIL pdl_clan_assembly_reform monarchy" }
	}
}

country_event = {
	id = rip_gov_test.1068
	title = rip_gov_test.t
	desc = rip_gov_test.d
	picture = ADMINISTRATIVE_REFORM_eventPicture
	hidden = yes
	is_triggered_only = yes
	option = { name = rip_gov_test.a }
	immediate = {
		# pdl_frontier_voivodeship_reform | monarchy | feudalism_vs_autocracy
		log = "RIP_GOV_TEST BEGIN pdl_frontier_voivodeship_reform monarchy"
		country_event = { id = rip_gov_test.90 }
		# a switch to another type drops every reform; the switch back leaves the basic one
		change_government = republic
		change_government = monarchy
		if = { limit = { NOT = { tag = PDL } }
			if = { limit = { exists = PDL } inherit = PDL }
			change_tag = PDL
			on_change_tag_effect = yes
		}
		clr_country_flag = pdl_carpathian_path
		clr_country_flag = pdl_frontier_path
		clr_country_flag = pdl_magnate_path
		if = { limit = { NOT = { tag = PDL } } set_country_flag = rip_gov_test_fail log = "RIP_GOV_TEST GRANT_FAIL pdl_frontier_voivodeship_reform monarchy tag:PDL" }
		set_country_flag = rip_gov_test_chk_pot
		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					has_reform = pdl_frontier_voivodeship_reform
					AND = {
						west_ukraine_pdl_origin_country = yes
						NOT = { has_country_flag = pdl_carpathian_path }
						NOT = { has_country_flag = pdl_frontier_path }
						NOT = { has_country_flag = pdl_magnate_path }
					}
				}
			}
			clr_country_flag = rip_gov_test_chk_pot
			log = "RIP_GOV_TEST POT_OK pdl_frontier_voivodeship_reform monarchy"
		}

		set_country_flag = rip_gov_test_chk_trg

			limit = {
				OR = {
					has_reform = pdl_frontier_voivodeship_reform
					AND = {
						west_ukraine_pdl_origin_country = yes
						NOT = { has_country_flag = pdl_carpathian_path }
						NOT = { has_country_flag = pdl_frontier_path }
						NOT = { has_country_flag = pdl_magnate_path }
					}
				}
			}
			clr_country_flag = rip_gov_test_chk_trg
			log = "RIP_GOV_TEST TRG_OK pdl_frontier_voivodeship_reform monarchy"
		}
		if = { limit = { has_country_flag = rip_gov_test_chk_trg } clr_country_flag = rip_gov_test_chk_trg set_country_flag = rip_gov_test_fail log = "RIP_GOV_TEST TRG_FAIL pdl_frontier_voivodeship_reform monarchy" }

				has_institution = enlightenment
			}
			clr_country_flag = rip_gov_test_chk_trg
			log = "RIP_GOV_TEST TRG_OK pdl_enlightened_voivodeship_reform monarchy"
		}
		if = { limit = { has_country_flag = rip_gov_test_chk_trg } clr_country_flag = rip_gov_test_chk_trg set_country_flag = rip_gov_test_fail log = "RIP_GOV_TEST TRG_FAIL pdl_enlightened_voivodeship_reform monarchy" }
		add_government_reform = pdl_enlightened_voivodeship_reform
		if = { limit = { has_reform = pdl_enlightened_voivodeship_reform } log = "RIP_GOV_TEST HELD_OK pdl_enlightened_voivodeship_reform monarchy" }
		if = { limit = { NOT = { has_reform = pdl_enlightened_voivodeship_reform } } set_country_flag = rip_gov_test_fail log = "RIP_GOV_TEST HELD_FAIL pdl_enlightened_voivodeship_reform monarchy" }

		log = "RIP_GOV_TEST BEGIN pdl_revolutionary_republic_reform monarchy"

		change_government = monarchy

			on_change_tag_effect = yes

		set_country_flag = pdl_frontier_path
		if = { limit = { NOT = { tag = PDL } } set_country_flag = rip_gov_test_fail log = "RIP_GOV_TEST GRANT_FAIL pdl_revolutionary_republic_reform monarchy tag:PDL" }

			}

		}
		if = { limit = { has_country_flag = rip_gov_test_chk_pot } clr_country_flag = rip_gov_test_chk_pot set_country_flag = rip_gov_test_fail log = "RIP_GOV_TEST POT_FAIL pdl_revolutionary_republic_reform monarchy" }

		if = {
			limit = {

					current_age = age_of_revolutions
					is_revolutionary = yes
				}

			log = "RIP_GOV_TEST TRG_OK pdl_revolutionary_republic_reform monarchy"
		}
		if = { limit = { has_country_flag = rip_gov_test_chk_trg } clr_country_flag = rip_gov_test_chk_trg set_country_flag = rip_gov_test_fail log = "RIP_GOV_TEST TRG_FAIL pdl_revolutionary_republic_reform monarchy" }

		if = { limit = { has_reform = pdl_revolutionary_republic_reform } log = "RIP_GOV_TEST HELD_OK pdl_revolutionary_republic_reform monarchy" }
		if = { limit = { NOT = { has_reform = pdl_revolutionary_republic_reform } } set_country_flag = rip_gov_test_fail log = "RIP_GOV_TEST HELD_FAIL pdl_revolutionary_republic_reform monarchy" }

country_event = {
	id = rip_gov_test.1084
	title = rip_gov_test.t
	desc = rip_gov_test.d
	picture = ADMINISTRATIVE_REFORM_eventPicture
	hidden = yes
	is_triggered_only = yes
	option = { name = rip_gov_test.a }
	immediate = {
		# prl_episcopal_authority_reform | monarchy | state_and_religion
		log = "RIP_GOV_TEST BEGIN prl_episcopal_authority_reform monarchy"
		country_event = { id = rip_gov_test.90 }
		# a switch to another type drops every reform; the switch back leaves the basic one
		change_government = republic
		change_government = monarchy
		if = { limit = { NOT = { tag = PRL } }
			if = { limit = { exists = PRL } inherit = PRL }
			change_tag = PRL
			on_change_tag_effect = yes
		}
		if = { limit = { NOT = { religion = orthodox } } change_religion = orthodox }
		if = { limit = { NOT = { adm_tech = 15 } } add_adm_tech = 15 }
		if = { limit = { NOT = { tag = PRL } } set_country_flag = rip_gov_test_fail log = "RIP_GOV_TEST GRANT_FAIL prl_episcopal_authority_reform monarchy tag:PRL" }
		if = { limit = { NOT = { religion = orthodox } } set_country_flag = rip_gov_test_fail log = "RIP_GOV_TEST GRANT_FAIL prl_episcopal_authority_reform monarchy religion:orthodox" }
		if = { limit = { NOT = { adm_tech = 15 } } set_country_flag = rip_gov_test_fail log = "RIP_GOV_TEST GRANT_FAIL prl_episcopal_authority_reform monarchy stat:adm_tech" }
		set_country_flag = rip_gov_test_chk_pot
		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					has_reform = prl_episcopal_authority_reform
					AND = {
						tag = PRL
						OR = {
							religion = orthodox
							religion = russian_orthodox
							religion = greek_catholic
						}
					}
				}
			}
			clr_country_flag = rip_gov_test_chk_pot
			log = "RIP_GOV_TEST POT_OK prl_episcopal_authority_reform monarchy"
		}
		if = { limit = { has_country_flag = rip_gov_test_chk_pot } clr_country_flag = rip_gov_test_chk_pot set_country_flag = rip_gov_test_fail log = "RIP_GOV_TEST POT_FAIL prl_episcopal_authority_reform monarchy" }
		set_country_flag = rip_gov_test_chk_trg
		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					has_reform = prl_episcopal_authority_reform
					AND = {
						tag = PRL
						OR = {
							religion = orthodox
							religion = russian_orthodox
							religion = greek_catholic
						}
						OR = {
							mission_completed = prl_episcopal_authority
							adm_tech = 15
						}
					}
				}
			}
			clr_country_flag = rip_gov_test_chk_trg
			log = "RIP_GOV_TEST TRG_OK prl_episcopal_authority_reform monarchy"
		}
		if = { limit = { has_country_flag = rip_gov_test_chk_trg } clr_country_flag = rip_gov_test_chk_trg set_country_flag = rip_gov_test_fail log = "RIP_GOV_TEST TRG_FAIL prl_episcopal_authority_reform monarchy" }
		add_government_reform = prl_episcopal_authority_reform
		if = { limit = { has_reform = prl_episcopal_authority_reform } log = "RIP_GOV_TEST HELD_OK prl_episcopal_authority_reform monarchy" }
		if = { limit = { NOT = { has_reform = prl_episcopal_authority_reform } } set_country_flag = rip_gov_test_fail log = "RIP_GOV_TEST HELD_FAIL prl_episcopal_authority_reform monarchy" }
	}
}

	title = rip_gov_test.t
	desc = rip_gov_test.d
	picture = ADMINISTRATIVE_REFORM_eventPicture
	hidden = yes
	is_triggered_only = yes
	option = { name = rip_gov_test.a }
	immediate = {
		# uzh_komitat_system_reform | monarchy | feudalism_vs_autocracy
		log = "RIP_GOV_TEST BEGIN uzh_komitat_system_reform monarchy"
		country_event = { id = rip_gov_test.90 }
		# a switch to another type drops every reform; the switch back leaves the basic one
		change_government = republic
		change_government = monarchy
		if = { limit = { NOT = { tag = UZH } }
			if = { limit = { exists = UZH } inherit = UZH }
			change_tag = UZH
			on_change_tag_effect = yes
		}
		if = { limit = { NOT = { tag = UZH } } set_country_flag = rip_gov_test_fail log = "RIP_GOV_TEST GRANT_FAIL uzh_komitat_system_reform monarchy tag:UZH" }
		set_country_flag = rip_gov_test_chk_pot
		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					has_reform = uzh_komitat_system_reform
					tag = UZH
				}
			}
			clr_country_flag = rip_gov_test_chk_pot
			log = "RIP_GOV_TEST POT_OK uzh_komitat_system_reform monarchy"
		}
		if = { limit = { has_country_flag = rip_gov_test_chk_pot } clr_country_flag = rip_gov_test_chk_pot set_country_flag = rip_gov_test_fail log = "RIP_GOV_TEST POT_FAIL uzh_komitat_system_reform monarchy" }
		set_country_flag = rip_gov_test_chk_trg
		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					has_reform = uzh_komitat_system_reform
					tag = UZH
				}
			}
			clr_country_flag = rip_gov_test_chk_trg
			log = "RIP_GOV_TEST TRG_OK uzh_komitat_system_reform monarchy"
		}
		if = { limit = { has_country_flag = rip_gov_test_chk_trg } clr_country_flag = rip_gov_test_chk_trg set_country_flag = rip_gov_test_fail log = "RIP_GOV_TEST TRG_FAIL uzh_komitat_system_reform monarchy" }
		add_government_reform = uzh_komitat_system_reform
		if = { limit = { has_reform = uzh_komitat_system_reform } log = "RIP_GOV_TEST HELD_OK uzh_komitat_system_reform monarchy" }
		if = { limit = { NOT = { has_reform = uzh_komitat_system_reform } } set_country_flag = rip_gov_test_fail log = "RIP_GOV_TEST HELD_FAIL uzh_komitat_system_reform monarchy" }
	}
}

country_event = {
	id = rip_gov_test.1091
	title = rip_gov_test.t
	desc = rip_gov_test.d
	picture = ADMINISTRATIVE_REFORM_eventPicture
	hidden = yes
	is_triggered_only = yes
	option = { name = rip_gov_test.a }
	immediate = {
		# uzh_union_synod_reform | monarchy | state_and_religion
		log = "RIP_GOV_TEST BEGIN uzh_union_synod_reform monarchy"
		country_event = { id = rip_gov_test.90 }
		# a switch to another type drops every reform; the switch back leaves the basic one
		change_government = republic
		change_government = monarchy
		set_country_flag = uzh_union_synod_established
		if = { limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = uzh_union_synod_established } } set_country_flag = rip_gov_test_fail log = "RIP_GOV_TEST GRANT_FAIL uzh_union_synod_reform monarchy flag:uzh_union_synod_established" }
		set_country_flag = rip_gov_test_chk_pot
		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					has_reform = uzh_union_synod_reform
					tag = UZH
					has_country_flag = uzh_union_synod_established
				}
			}
			clr_country_flag = rip_gov_test_chk_pot
			log = "RIP_GOV_TEST POT_OK uzh_union_synod_reform monarchy"
		}
		if = { limit = { has_country_flag = rip_gov_test_chk_pot } clr_country_flag = rip_gov_test_chk_pot set_country_flag = rip_gov_test_fail log = "RIP_GOV_TEST POT_FAIL uzh_union_synod_reform monarchy" }
		set_country_flag = rip_gov_test_chk_trg
		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					has_reform = uzh_union_synod_reform
					AND = {
						is_year = 1646
						has_country_flag = uzh_union_synod_established
					}
				}
			}
			clr_country_flag = rip_gov_test_chk_trg
			log = "RIP_GOV_TEST TRG_OK uzh_union_synod_reform monarchy"
		}
		if = { limit = { has_country_flag = rip_gov_test_chk_trg } clr_country_flag = rip_gov_test_chk_trg set_country_flag = rip_gov_test_fail log = "RIP_GOV_TEST TRG_FAIL uzh_union_synod_reform monarchy" }
		add_government_reform = uzh_union_synod_reform
		if = { limit = { has_reform = uzh_union_synod_reform } log = "RIP_GOV_TEST HELD_OK uzh_union_synod_reform monarchy" }
		if = { limit = { NOT = { has_reform = uzh_union_synod_reform } } set_country_flag = rip_gov_test_fail log = "RIP_GOV_TEST HELD_FAIL uzh_union_synod_reform monarchy" }
	}
}

	picture = ADMINISTRATIVE_REFORM_eventPicture
	hidden = yes
	is_triggered_only = yes
	option = { name = rip_gov_test.a }
	immediate = {
		# uzh_palatial_rusyn_reform | monarchy | absolute_rule_vs_constitutional
		log = "RIP_GOV_TEST BEGIN uzh_palatial_rusyn_reform monarchy"
		country_event = { id = rip_gov_test.90 }
		# a switch to another type drops every reform; the switch back leaves the basic one
		change_government = republic
		change_government = monarchy

			if = { limit = { exists = UZH } inherit = UZH }
			change_tag = UZH
			on_change_tag_effect = yes
		}
		set_country_flag = chose_rusyn_identity
		if = { limit = { NOT = { tag = UZH } } set_country_flag = rip_gov_test_fail log = "RIP_GOV_TEST GRANT_FAIL uzh_palatial_rusyn_reform monarchy tag:UZH" }

		set_country_flag = rip_gov_test_chk_pot
		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					has_reform = uzh_palatial_rusyn_reform
					tag = UZH
				}
			}
			clr_country_flag = rip_gov_test_chk_pot
			log = "RIP_GOV_TEST POT_OK uzh_palatial_rusyn_reform monarchy"
		}
		if = { limit = { has_country_flag = rip_gov_test_chk_pot } clr_country_flag = rip_gov_test_chk_pot set_country_flag = rip_gov_test_fail log = "RIP_GOV_TEST POT_FAIL uzh_palatial_rusyn_reform monarchy" }

		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					has_reform = uzh_palatial_rusyn_reform
					AND = {
						tag = UZH
						custom_trigger_tooltip = {
							tooltip = uzh_palatial_rusyn_identity_req_tt
							uzh_identity_rusyn_selected = yes
						}
					}
				}
			}
			clr_country_flag = rip_gov_test_chk_trg
			log = "RIP_GOV_TEST TRG_OK uzh_palatial_rusyn_reform monarchy"
		}
		if = { limit = { has_country_flag = rip_gov_test_chk_trg } clr_country_flag = rip_gov_test_chk_trg set_country_flag = rip_gov_test_fail log = "RIP_GOV_TEST TRG_FAIL uzh_palatial_rusyn_reform monarchy" }

		if = { limit = { has_reform = uzh_palatial_rusyn_reform } log = "RIP_GOV_TEST HELD_OK uzh_palatial_rusyn_reform monarchy" }

country_event = {
	id = rip_gov_test.1099
	title = rip_gov_test.t
	desc = rip_gov_test.d
	picture = ADMINISTRATIVE_REFORM_eventPicture
	hidden = yes
	is_triggered_only = yes
	option = { name = rip_gov_test.a }
	immediate = {
		# uzh_union_synod_reform | republic | republic_and_religion
		log = "RIP_GOV_TEST BEGIN uzh_union_synod_reform republic"
		country_event = { id = rip_gov_test.90 }
		# a switch to another type drops every reform; the switch back leaves the basic one
		change_government = monarchy
		change_government = republic
		set_country_flag = uzh_union_synod_established
		if = { limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = uzh_union_synod_established } } set_country_flag = rip_gov_test_fail log = "RIP_GOV_TEST GRANT_FAIL uzh_union_synod_reform republic flag:uzh_union_synod_established" }
		set_country_flag = rip_gov_test_chk_pot
		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					has_reform = uzh_union_synod_reform
					tag = UZH
					has_country_flag = uzh_union_synod_established
				}
			}
			clr_country_flag = rip_gov_test_chk_pot
			log = "RIP_GOV_TEST POT_OK uzh_union_synod_reform republic"
		}
		if = { limit = { has_country_flag = rip_gov_test_chk_pot } clr_country_flag = rip_gov_test_chk_pot set_country_flag = rip_gov_test_fail log = "RIP_GOV_TEST POT_FAIL uzh_union_synod_reform republic" }
		set_country_flag = rip_gov_test_chk_trg
		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					has_reform = uzh_union_synod_reform
					AND = {
						is_year = 1646
						has_country_flag = uzh_union_synod_established
					}
				}
			}
			clr_country_flag = rip_gov_test_chk_trg
			log = "RIP_GOV_TEST TRG_OK uzh_union_synod_reform republic"
		}
		if = { limit = { has_country_flag = rip_gov_test_chk_trg } clr_country_flag = rip_gov_test_chk_trg set_country_flag = rip_gov_test_fail log = "RIP_GOV_TEST TRG_FAIL uzh_union_synod_reform republic" }
		add_government_reform = uzh_union_synod_reform
		if = { limit = { has_reform = uzh_union_synod_reform } log = "RIP_GOV_TEST HELD_OK uzh_union_synod_reform republic" }
		if = { limit = { NOT = { has_reform = uzh_union_synod_reform } } set_country_flag = rip_gov_test_fail log = "RIP_GOV_TEST HELD_FAIL uzh_union_synod_reform republic" }
	}
}

		log = "RIP_GOV_TEST BEGIN uzh_mukachevo_eparchy_reform theocracy"
		country_event = { id = rip_gov_test.90 }
		# a switch to another type drops every reform; the switch back leaves the basic one
		change_government = monarchy
		change_government = theocracy

			on_change_tag_effect = yes
		}
		set_country_flag = uzh_eparchial_rule_established
		if = { limit = { NOT = { tag = UZH } } set_country_flag = rip_gov_test_fail log = "RIP_GOV_TEST GRANT_FAIL uzh_mukachevo_eparchy_reform theocracy tag:UZH" }

						has_country_flag = uzh_eparchial_rule_established
					}
				}
			}

				OR = {
					has_reform = uzh_mukachevo_eparchy_reform
					AND = {
						tag = UZH
						has_country_flag = uzh_eparchial_rule_established
					}
				}
			}
			clr_country_flag = rip_gov_test_chk_trg
			log = "RIP_GOV_TEST TRG_OK uzh_mukachevo_eparchy_reform theocracy"
		}
		if = { limit = { has_country_flag = rip_gov_test_chk_trg } clr_country_flag = rip_gov_test_chk_trg set_country_flag = rip_gov_test_fail log = "RIP_GOV_TEST TRG_FAIL uzh_mukachevo_eparchy_reform theocracy" }

	picture = ADMINISTRATIVE_REFORM_eventPicture
	hidden = yes
	is_triggered_only = yes
	option = { name = rip_gov_test.a }
	immediate = {
		# grand_duchy_reform | monarchy | feudalism_vs_autocracy
		log = "RIP_GOV_TEST BEGIN grand_duchy_reform monarchy"
		country_event = { id = rip_gov_test.90 }
		# a switch to another type drops every reform; the switch back leaves the basic one
		change_government = republic
		change_government = monarchy
		if = { limit = { NOT = { tag = LIT } }
			if = { limit = { exists = LIT } inherit = LIT }
			change_tag = LIT
			on_change_tag_effect = yes
		}
		if = { limit = { NOT = { tag = LIT } } set_country_flag = rip_gov_test_fail log = "RIP_GOV_TEST GRANT_FAIL grand_duchy_reform monarchy tag:LIT" }
		set_country_flag = rip_gov_test_chk_pot
		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					AND = {
						tag = LIT
						NOT = { map_setup = map_setup_random }
					}
					has_reform = grand_duchy_reform
					AND = {
						is_playing_custom_nation = yes
						have_had_reform = grand_duchy_reform
					}
				}
			}
			clr_country_flag = rip_gov_test_chk_pot
			log = "RIP_GOV_TEST POT_OK grand_duchy_reform monarchy"
		}
		if = { limit = { has_country_flag = rip_gov_test_chk_pot } clr_country_flag = rip_gov_test_chk_pot set_country_flag = rip_gov_test_fail log = "RIP_GOV_TEST POT_FAIL grand_duchy_reform monarchy" }
		log = "RIP_GOV_TEST TRG_NONE grand_duchy_reform monarchy"
		add_government_reform = grand_duchy_reform
		if = { limit = { has_reform = grand_duchy_reform } log = "RIP_GOV_TEST HELD_OK grand_duchy_reform monarchy" }
		if = { limit = { NOT = { has_reform = grand_duchy_reform } } set_country_flag = rip_gov_test_fail log = "RIP_GOV_TEST HELD_FAIL grand_duchy_reform monarchy" }
	}
}

country_event = {

	title = rip_gov_test.t
	desc = rip_gov_test.d
	picture = ADMINISTRATIVE_REFORM_eventPicture
	hidden = yes
	is_triggered_only = yes
	option = { name = rip_gov_test.a }
	immediate = {
		# elected_assemblies_reform | monarchy | hereditary_vs_nobility
		log = "RIP_GOV_TEST BEGIN elected_assemblies_reform monarchy"
		country_event = { id = rip_gov_test.90 }
		# a switch to another type drops every reform; the switch back leaves the basic one
		change_government = republic
		change_government = monarchy
		if = { limit = { NOT = { tag = KRU } }
			if = { limit = { exists = KRU } inherit = KRU }
			change_tag = KRU
			on_change_tag_effect = yes
		}
		add_government_reform = kyivan_rus_reform
		if = { limit = { NOT = { tag = KRU } } set_country_flag = rip_gov_test_fail log = "RIP_GOV_TEST GRANT_FAIL elected_assemblies_reform monarchy tag:KRU" }
		if = { limit = { NOT = { has_reform = kyivan_rus_reform } } set_country_flag = rip_gov_test_fail log = "RIP_GOV_TEST GRANT_FAIL elected_assemblies_reform monarchy reform:kyivan_rus_reform" }
		set_country_flag = rip_gov_test_chk_pot
		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					has_reform = elected_assemblies_reform
					has_reform = kyivan_rus_reform
				}
			}
			clr_country_flag = rip_gov_test_chk_pot
			log = "RIP_GOV_TEST POT_OK elected_assemblies_reform monarchy"
		}
		if = { limit = { has_country_flag = rip_gov_test_chk_pot } clr_country_flag = rip_gov_test_chk_pot set_country_flag = rip_gov_test_fail log = "RIP_GOV_TEST POT_FAIL elected_assemblies_reform monarchy" }

		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					has_reform = elected_assemblies_reform
					has_reform = kyivan_rus_reform
				}
			}
			clr_country_flag = rip_gov_test_chk_trg
			log = "RIP_GOV_TEST TRG_OK elected_assemblies_reform monarchy"
		}
		if = { limit = { has_country_flag = rip_gov_test_chk_trg } clr_country_flag = rip_gov_test_chk_trg set_country_flag = rip_gov_test_fail log = "RIP_GOV_TEST TRG_FAIL elected_assemblies_reform monarchy" }

	hidden = yes
	is_triggered_only = yes
	option = { name = rip_gov_test.a }
	immediate = {
		# patriarch_engagement_reform | monarchy | state_and_religion
		log = "RIP_GOV_TEST BEGIN patriarch_engagement_reform monarchy"
		country_event = { id = rip_gov_test.90 }
		# a switch to another type drops every reform; the switch back leaves the basic one
		change_government = republic
		change_government = monarchy
		if = { limit = { NOT = { religion = orthodox } } change_religion = orthodox }
		if = { limit = { NOT = { primary_culture = ruthenian } } change_primary_culture = ruthenian }
		if = { limit = { NOT = { religion = orthodox } } set_country_flag = rip_gov_test_fail log = "RIP_GOV_TEST GRANT_FAIL patriarch_engagement_reform monarchy religion:orthodox" }
		if = { limit = { NOT = { primary_culture = ruthenian } } set_country_flag = rip_gov_test_fail log = "RIP_GOV_TEST GRANT_FAIL patriarch_engagement_reform monarchy culture:ruthenian" }
		set_country_flag = rip_gov_test_chk_pot
		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					has_reform = patriarch_engagement_reform
					AND = {
						ruthenian_reform_visible = yes
						OR = {
							religion = orthodox
							religion = russian_orthodox
							religion = greek_catholic
						}
					}
				}
			}
			clr_country_flag = rip_gov_test_chk_pot
			log = "RIP_GOV_TEST POT_OK patriarch_engagement_reform monarchy"
		}
		if = { limit = { has_country_flag = rip_gov_test_chk_pot } clr_country_flag = rip_gov_test_chk_pot set_country_flag = rip_gov_test_fail log = "RIP_GOV_TEST POT_FAIL patriarch_engagement_reform monarchy" }
		set_country_flag = rip_gov_test_chk_trg
		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					has_reform = patriarch_engagement_reform
					AND = {
						ruthenian_reform_eligible = yes
						OR = {
							religion = orthodox
							religion = russian_orthodox
							religion = greek_catholic
						}
					}
				}
			}
			clr_country_flag = rip_gov_test_chk_trg
			log = "RIP_GOV_TEST TRG_OK patriarch_engagement_reform monarchy"
		}
		if = { limit = { has_country_flag = rip_gov_test_chk_trg } clr_country_flag = rip_gov_test_chk_trg set_country_flag = rip_gov_test_fail log = "RIP_GOV_TEST TRG_FAIL patriarch_engagement_reform monarchy" }

	id = rip_gov_test.1125
	title = rip_gov_test.t
	desc = rip_gov_test.d
	picture = ADMINISTRATIVE_REFORM_eventPicture
	hidden = yes
	is_triggered_only = yes
	option = { name = rip_gov_test.a }
	immediate = {
		# vln_ruthenian_renaissance_reform | monarchy | growth_of_administration
		log = "RIP_GOV_TEST BEGIN vln_ruthenian_renaissance_reform monarchy"
		country_event = { id = rip_gov_test.90 }
		# a switch to another type drops every reform; the switch back leaves the basic one
		change_government = republic
		change_government = monarchy
		if = { limit = { NOT = { primary_culture = ruthenian } } change_primary_culture = ruthenian }
		if = { limit = { is_institution_enabled = renaissance } capital_scope = { add_institution_embracement = { which = renaissance value = 100 } } }
		if = { limit = { NOT = { primary_culture = ruthenian } } set_country_flag = rip_gov_test_fail log = "RIP_GOV_TEST GRANT_FAIL vln_ruthenian_renaissance_reform monarchy culture:ruthenian" }
		set_country_flag = rip_gov_test_chk_pot
		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					has_reform = vln_ruthenian_renaissance_reform
					ruthenian_reform_visible = yes
				}
			}
			clr_country_flag = rip_gov_test_chk_pot
			log = "RIP_GOV_TEST POT_OK vln_ruthenian_renaissance_reform monarchy"
		}
		if = { limit = { has_country_flag = rip_gov_test_chk_pot } clr_country_flag = rip_gov_test_chk_pot set_country_flag = rip_gov_test_fail log = "RIP_GOV_TEST POT_FAIL vln_ruthenian_renaissance_reform monarchy" }
		set_country_flag = rip_gov_test_chk_trg
		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					has_reform = vln_ruthenian_renaissance_reform
					AND = {
						ruthenian_reform_eligible = yes
						has_institution = renaissance
						num_of_owned_provinces_with = {
							value = 3
							development = 20
							OR = {
								culture = ruthenian
								culture = rusyn
								culture = ruthenian_new
								culture = rusyn_new
								culture = rusyn_new_new
							}
						}
					}
				}
			}
			clr_country_flag = rip_gov_test_chk_trg
			log = "RIP_GOV_TEST TRG_OK vln_ruthenian_renaissance_reform monarchy"
		}
		if = { limit = { has_country_flag = rip_gov_test_chk_trg } clr_country_flag = rip_gov_test_chk_trg set_country_flag = rip_gov_test_fail log = "RIP_GOV_TEST TRG_FAIL vln_ruthenian_renaissance_reform monarchy" }
		add_government_reform = vln_ruthenian_renaissance_reform
		if = { limit = { has_reform = vln_ruthenian_renaissance_reform } log = "RIP_GOV_TEST HELD_OK vln_ruthenian_renaissance_reform monarchy" }
		if = { limit = { NOT = { has_reform = vln_ruthenian_renaissance_reform } } set_country_flag = rip_gov_test_fail log = "RIP_GOV_TEST HELD_FAIL vln_ruthenian_renaissance_reform monarchy" }

		set_country_flag = rip_gov_test_chk_pot
		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					has_reform = vln_magdeburg_rights
					ruthenian_reform_visible = yes
				}
			}
			clr_country_flag = rip_gov_test_chk_pot
			log = "RIP_GOV_TEST POT_OK vln_magdeburg_rights monarchy"
		}
		if = { limit = { has_country_flag = rip_gov_test_chk_pot } clr_country_flag = rip_gov_test_chk_pot set_country_flag = rip_gov_test_fail log = "RIP_GOV_TEST POT_FAIL vln_magdeburg_rights monarchy" }
		set_country_flag = rip_gov_test_chk_trg
		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					has_reform = vln_magdeburg_rights
					AND = {
						ruthenian_reform_eligible = yes
						num_of_owned_provinces_with = {
							value = 5
							development = 10
						}
					}
				}
			}
			clr_country_flag = rip_gov_test_chk_trg
			log = "RIP_GOV_TEST TRG_OK vln_magdeburg_rights monarchy"
		}
		if = { limit = { has_country_flag = rip_gov_test_chk_trg } clr_country_flag = rip_gov_test_chk_trg set_country_flag = rip_gov_test_fail log = "RIP_GOV_TEST TRG_FAIL vln_magdeburg_rights monarchy" }
		add_government_reform = vln_magdeburg_rights
		if = { limit = { has_reform = vln_magdeburg_rights } log = "RIP_GOV_TEST HELD_OK vln_magdeburg_rights monarchy" }
		if = { limit = { NOT = { has_reform = vln_magdeburg_rights } } set_country_flag = rip_gov_test_fail log = "RIP_GOV_TEST HELD_FAIL vln_magdeburg_rights monarchy" }
	}
}

country_event = {
	id = rip_gov_test.1130
	title = rip_gov_test.t
	desc = rip_gov_test.d
	picture = ADMINISTRATIVE_REFORM_eventPicture
	hidden = yes
	is_triggered_only = yes
	option = { name = rip_gov_test.a }
	immediate = {
		# representation_monarchy_reform | monarchy | absolute_rule_vs_constitutional
		log = "RIP_GOV_TEST BEGIN representation_monarchy_reform monarchy"
		country_event = { id = rip_gov_test.90 }
		# a switch to another type drops every reform; the switch back leaves the basic one
		change_government = republic
		change_government = monarchy
		if = { limit = { NOT = { tag = KRU } }
			if = { limit = { exists = KRU } inherit = KRU }
			change_tag = KRU
			on_change_tag_effect = yes
		}
		add_government_reform = kyivan_rus_reform
		add_government_reform = boyar_elite_reform
		if = { limit = { NOT = { tag = KRU } } set_country_flag = rip_gov_test_fail log = "RIP_GOV_TEST GRANT_FAIL representation_monarchy_reform monarchy tag:KRU" }
		if = { limit = { NOT = { has_reform = kyivan_rus_reform } } set_country_flag = rip_gov_test_fail log = "RIP_GOV_TEST GRANT_FAIL representation_monarchy_reform monarchy reform:kyivan_rus_reform" }
		if = { limit = { NOT = { has_reform = boyar_elite_reform } } set_country_flag = rip_gov_test_fail log = "RIP_GOV_TEST GRANT_FAIL representation_monarchy_reform monarchy reform:boyar_elite_reform" }
		set_country_flag = rip_gov_test_chk_pot
		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					has_reform = representation_monarchy_reform
					AND = {
						has_reform = boyar_elite_reform
						has_reform = kyivan_rus_reform
					}
				}
			}
			clr_country_flag = rip_gov_test_chk_pot
			log = "RIP_GOV_TEST POT_OK representation_monarchy_reform monarchy"
		}
		if = { limit = { has_country_flag = rip_gov_test_chk_pot } clr_country_flag = rip_gov_test_chk_pot set_country_flag = rip_gov_test_fail log = "RIP_GOV_TEST POT_FAIL representation_monarchy_reform monarchy" }
		set_country_flag = rip_gov_test_chk_trg
		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					has_reform = representation_monarchy_reform
					AND = {
						has_reform = boyar_elite_reform
						has_reform = kyivan_rus_reform
					}
				}
			}
			clr_country_flag = rip_gov_test_chk_trg
			log = "RIP_GOV_TEST TRG_OK representation_monarchy_reform monarchy"
		}
		if = { limit = { has_country_flag = rip_gov_test_chk_trg } clr_country_flag = rip_gov_test_chk_trg set_country_flag = rip_gov_test_fail log = "RIP_GOV_TEST TRG_FAIL representation_monarchy_reform monarchy" }
		add_government_reform = representation_monarchy_reform

						}

country_event = {
	id = rip_gov_test.1141
	title = rip_gov_test.t
	desc = rip_gov_test.d
	picture = ADMINISTRATIVE_REFORM_eventPicture
	hidden = yes
	is_triggered_only = yes
	option = { name = rip_gov_test.a }
	immediate = {
		# ruthenian_factional_empire_reform | monarchy | feudalism_vs_autocracy
		log = "RIP_GOV_TEST BEGIN ruthenian_factional_empire_reform monarchy"
		country_event = { id = rip_gov_test.90 }
		# a switch to another type drops every reform; the switch back leaves the basic one
		change_government = republic
		change_government = monarchy
		if = { limit = { NOT = { tag = KRU } }
			if = { limit = { exists = KRU } inherit = KRU }
			change_tag = KRU
			on_change_tag_effect = yes
		}
		if = { limit = { NOT = { tag = KRU } } set_country_flag = rip_gov_test_fail log = "RIP_GOV_TEST GRANT_FAIL ruthenian_factional_empire_reform monarchy tag:KRU" }
		set_country_flag = rip_gov_test_chk_pot
		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					has_reform = ruthenian_factional_empire_reform
					AND = {
						tag = KRU
						NOT = { has_reform = ruthenian_factional_empire_hetmans_princes_reform }
						NOT = { has_reform = ruthenian_factional_empire_princes_boyars_reform }
						NOT = { has_reform = ruthenian_factional_empire_hetmans_boyars_reform }
						NOT = { has_reform = ruthenian_factional_empire_princes_hetmans_reform }
						NOT = { has_reform = ruthenian_factional_empire_boyars_hetmans_reform }
					}
				}
			}
			clr_country_flag = rip_gov_test_chk_pot
			log = "RIP_GOV_TEST POT_OK ruthenian_factional_empire_reform monarchy"
		}
		if = { limit = { has_country_flag = rip_gov_test_chk_pot } clr_country_flag = rip_gov_test_chk_pot set_country_flag = rip_gov_test_fail log = "RIP_GOV_TEST POT_FAIL ruthenian_factional_empire_reform monarchy" }
		set_country_flag = rip_gov_test_chk_trg
		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					has_reform = ruthenian_factional_empire_reform
					tag = KRU
				}
			}
			clr_country_flag = rip_gov_test_chk_trg
			log = "RIP_GOV_TEST TRG_OK ruthenian_factional_empire_reform monarchy"
		}
		if = { limit = { has_country_flag = rip_gov_test_chk_trg } clr_country_flag = rip_gov_test_chk_trg set_country_flag = rip_gov_test_fail log = "RIP_GOV_TEST TRG_FAIL ruthenian_factional_empire_reform monarchy" }
		add_government_reform = ruthenian_factional_empire_reform
		if = { limit = { has_reform = ruthenian_factional_empire_reform } log = "RIP_GOV_TEST HELD_OK ruthenian_factional_empire_reform monarchy" }
		if = { limit = { NOT = { has_reform = ruthenian_factional_empire_reform } } set_country_flag = rip_gov_test_fail log = "RIP_GOV_TEST HELD_FAIL ruthenian_factional_empire_reform monarchy" }
	}
}

country_event = {
	id = rip_gov_test.1143
	title = rip_gov_test.t
	desc = rip_gov_test.d
	picture = ADMINISTRATIVE_REFORM_eventPicture
	hidden = yes
	is_triggered_only = yes
	option = { name = rip_gov_test.a }
	immediate = {
		# principality | monarchy | feudalism_vs_autocracy
		log = "RIP_GOV_TEST BEGIN principality monarchy"
		country_event = { id = rip_gov_test.90 }
		# a switch to another type drops every reform; the switch back leaves the basic one
		change_government = republic
		change_government = monarchy
		if = { limit = { NOT = { religion = orthodox } } change_religion = orthodox }
		if = { limit = { NOT = { religion = orthodox } } set_country_flag = rip_gov_test_fail log = "RIP_GOV_TEST GRANT_FAIL principality monarchy religion:orthodox" }
		set_country_flag = rip_gov_test_chk_pot
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { has_reform = tsardom }
				OR = {
					religion = orthodox
					religion = russian_orthodox
				}
				OR = {
					culture_group = east_slavic
					culture_group = slavic
					AND = {
						is_playing_custom_nation = yes
						have_had_reform = principality
					}
				}
			}
			clr_country_flag = rip_gov_test_chk_pot
			log = "RIP_GOV_TEST POT_OK principality monarchy"
		}
		if = { limit = { has_country_flag = rip_gov_test_chk_pot } clr_country_flag = rip_gov_test_chk_pot set_country_flag = rip_gov_test_fail log = "RIP_GOV_TEST POT_FAIL principality monarchy" }
		log = "RIP_GOV_TEST TRG_NONE principality monarchy"
		add_government_reform = principality
		if = { limit = { has_reform = principality } log = "RIP_GOV_TEST HELD_OK principality monarchy" }
		if = { limit = { NOT = { has_reform = principality } } set_country_flag = rip_gov_test_fail log = "RIP_GOV_TEST HELD_FAIL principality monarchy" }
	}
}

country_event = {
	id = rip_gov_test.1144
	title = rip_gov_test.t
	desc = rip_gov_test.d
	picture = ADMINISTRATIVE_REFORM_eventPicture
	hidden = yes
	is_triggered_only = yes
	option = { name = rip_gov_test.a }
	immediate = {
		# tsardom | monarchy | feudalism_vs_autocracy
		log = "RIP_GOV_TEST BEGIN tsardom monarchy"
		country_event = { id = rip_gov_test.90 }
		# a switch to another type drops every reform; the switch back leaves the basic one
		change_government = republic
		change_government = monarchy
		if = { limit = { NOT = { tag = RUS } }
			if = { limit = { exists = RUS } inherit = RUS }
			change_tag = RUS
			on_change_tag_effect = yes
		}
		if = { limit = { NOT = { religion = orthodox } } change_religion = orthodox }
		if = { limit = { NOT = { tag = RUS } } set_country_flag = rip_gov_test_fail log = "RIP_GOV_TEST GRANT_FAIL tsardom monarchy tag:RUS" }
		if = { limit = { NOT = { religion = orthodox } } set_country_flag = rip_gov_test_fail log = "RIP_GOV_TEST GRANT_FAIL tsardom monarchy religion:orthodox" }
		set_country_flag = rip_gov_test_chk_pot
		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					religion = orthodox
					religion = russian_orthodox
				}
				OR = {
					culture_group = east_slavic
					culture_group = slavic
				}
				NOT = { primary_culture = ruthenian }
				NOT = { primary_culture = byelorussian }
				OR = {
					AND = {
						tag = RUS
						NOT = { map_setup = map_setup_random }
					}
					AND = {
						tag = UKR
						NOT = { map_setup = map_setup_random }
					}
					AND = {
						is_playing_custom_nation = yes
						have_had_reform = tsardom
					}
				}
			}
			clr_country_flag = rip_gov_test_chk_pot
			log = "RIP_GOV_TEST POT_OK tsardom monarchy"
		}
		if = { limit = { has_country_flag = rip_gov_test_chk_pot } clr_country_flag = rip_gov_test_chk_pot set_country_flag = rip_gov_test_fail log = "RIP_GOV_TEST POT_FAIL tsardom monarchy" }
		log = "RIP_GOV_TEST TRG_NONE tsardom monarchy"
		add_government_reform = tsardom
		if = { limit = { has_reform = tsardom } log = "RIP_GOV_TEST HELD_OK tsardom monarchy" }
		if = { limit = { NOT = { has_reform = tsardom } } set_country_flag = rip_gov_test_fail log = "RIP_GOV_TEST HELD_FAIL tsardom monarchy" }
	}
}

				}

	is_triggered_only = yes

	immediate = {
		# holy_synod_reform | monarchy | state_and_religion
		log = "RIP_GOV_TEST BEGIN holy_synod_reform monarchy"
		country_event = { id = rip_gov_test.90 }

		change_government = republic
		change_government = monarchy
		if = { limit = { NOT = { religion = orthodox } } change_religion = orthodox }
		add_government_reform = ruthenian_tsardom
		if = { limit = { NOT = { religion = orthodox } } set_country_flag = rip_gov_test_fail log = "RIP_GOV_TEST GRANT_FAIL holy_synod_reform monarchy religion:orthodox" }
		if = { limit = { NOT = { has_reform = ruthenian_tsardom } } set_country_flag = rip_gov_test_fail log = "RIP_GOV_TEST GRANT_FAIL holy_synod_reform monarchy reform:ruthenian_tsardom" }
		set_country_flag = rip_gov_test_chk_pot
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_dlc = "Domination"
				is_revolutionary = no
				NOT = { has_government_attribute = is_pirate_republic_reform }
				OR = {
					have_had_reform = holy_synod_reform
					has_unlocked_government_reform = { government_reform = holy_synod_reform }
					has_reform = ruthenian_tsardom
				}
			}
			clr_country_flag = rip_gov_test_chk_pot

		}
		if = { limit = { has_country_flag = rip_gov_test_chk_pot } clr_country_flag = rip_gov_test_chk_pot set_country_flag = rip_gov_test_fail log = "RIP_GOV_TEST POT_FAIL holy_synod_reform monarchy" }

				}

			log = "RIP_GOV_TEST TRG_OK holy_synod_reform monarchy"
		}
		if = { limit = { has_country_flag = rip_gov_test_chk_trg } clr_country_flag = rip_gov_test_chk_trg set_country_flag = rip_gov_test_fail log = "RIP_GOV_TEST TRG_FAIL holy_synod_reform monarchy" }

		log = "RIP_GOV_TEST BEGIN lands_for_the_monasteries_reform monarchy"

country_event = {
	id = rip_gov_test.1149
	title = rip_gov_test.t
	desc = rip_gov_test.d
	picture = ADMINISTRATIVE_REFORM_eventPicture
	hidden = yes
	is_triggered_only = yes
	option = { name = rip_gov_test.a }
	immediate = {
		# great_veche_republic | republic | oligarchy_merchant_class_noble_elite
		log = "RIP_GOV_TEST BEGIN great_veche_republic republic"
		country_event = { id = rip_gov_test.90 }
		# a switch to another type drops every reform; the switch back leaves the basic one
		change_government = monarchy
		change_government = republic
		if = { limit = { NOT = { tag = RUS } }
			if = { limit = { exists = RUS } inherit = RUS }
			change_tag = RUS
			on_change_tag_effect = yes
		}
		if = { limit = { NOT = { religion = orthodox } } change_religion = orthodox }
		if = { limit = { NOT = { tag = RUS } } set_country_flag = rip_gov_test_fail log = "RIP_GOV_TEST GRANT_FAIL great_veche_republic republic tag:RUS" }
		if = { limit = { NOT = { religion = orthodox } } set_country_flag = rip_gov_test_fail log = "RIP_GOV_TEST GRANT_FAIL great_veche_republic republic religion:orthodox" }
		set_country_flag = rip_gov_test_chk_pot
		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					culture_group = east_slavic
					culture_group = slavic
				}
				OR = {
					religion = orthodox
					religion = russian_orthodox
				}
				OR = {
					AND = {
						tag = RUS
						NOT = { map_setup = map_setup_random }
					}
					AND = {
						tag = UKR
						NOT = { map_setup = map_setup_random }
					}
					AND = {
						is_playing_custom_nation = yes
						have_had_reform = great_veche_republic
					}
				}
			}
			clr_country_flag = rip_gov_test_chk_pot
			log = "RIP_GOV_TEST POT_OK great_veche_republic republic"
		}
		if = { limit = { has_country_flag = rip_gov_test_chk_pot } clr_country_flag = rip_gov_test_chk_pot set_country_flag = rip_gov_test_fail log = "RIP_GOV_TEST POT_FAIL great_veche_republic republic" }
		log = "RIP_GOV_TEST TRG_NONE great_veche_republic republic"
		add_government_reform = great_veche_republic
		if = { limit = { has_reform = great_veche_republic } log = "RIP_GOV_TEST HELD_OK great_veche_republic republic" }
		if = { limit = { NOT = { has_reform = great_veche_republic } } set_country_flag = rip_gov_test_fail log = "RIP_GOV_TEST HELD_FAIL great_veche_republic republic" }
	}
}
